config_version.source: M1–M4 synthetic demonstration configuration based on the approved M0 contract

coverage_targets.source: Pasted M1 work brief. Report Monte Carlo sampling uncertainty and failures.

metal_window_ppm.source: Team specification §3.1. Audit tail and baseline sensitivity for the broad Table 6 line.

reference_window_ppm.source: Window for the simulated 20 ppm reference and flanking background

window_sensitivity_fraction.source: Change the fitted window width by this fraction in both directions

calibration_peak_snrs.source: No-peak and known-signal tests bracketing the proposed SNR thresholds

calibration_trials.source: Repeated trials for rate estimates on each synthetic case

censor_snr_candidate.source: Team specification §3.2 and pasted M2 brief. Evaluate with the full peak search.

comparability_and_residual_limits.source: Compare acquisition and operating conditions and screen residual lag-one correlation

detect_snr_candidate.source: Team specification §3.2 and pasted M2 brief. Evaluate with the full peak search.

metal_center_bounds_ppm.source: Approximate metallic-sodium shift range reported by Bray et al., Figure 5

reference_min_snr.source: Screen synthetic reference usability before normalizing

residual_lag1_max.source: Screen substantial lag-one residual correlation on native bins

upper_limit_center_step_ppm.source: Center grid spacing for the M2 finite template bank

upper_limit_confidence.source: Nominal one-sided confidence for the configured synthetic upper-limit construction

upper_limit_method.source: M2 fixed-width Gaussian linear templates and residual Student-t uncertainty; scope limited to the simulated noise model

acquired_complex_points.source: Simulator convention inspired by the paper's reported point count

cycle_count.source: Illustrative sequence with enough cycles to exercise a short-horizon forecast

fourier_points.source: Bray et al. Methods, zero-filled spectrum size

line_shape_cases.source: Ideal-model coverage case and Bray-informed shape mismatch case

metal_center_ppm.source: Bray et al. Supplementary Table 6, 1.5 h fit

metal_fwhm_ppm.source: Bray et al. Supplementary Table 6 linewidth of 12632 Hz, converted at about 105.9 MHz

reference_center_ppm.source: External NaCl reference scenario from team specification §3.3

spectral_width_ppm.source: Bray et al. Methods, full-cell spectroscopy

trajectory_protocol_and_noise.source: Invented single-cell schedule, acquisition protocol and SNR targets for the requested demonstration cases. The field and frequency are representative of Bray et al., not a reproduction of their settings.

adequate_sensitivity_margin.source: Dimensionless illustrative RMDI resolution margin. Includes observed change, random allowance and model sensitivity in the stability rule.

forecast_interval_level.source: M0 nominal coverage target. Include next-observation uncertainty and state assumptions.

forecast_min_points.source: Team specification §5.1 and the residual degrees of freedom of a local line

forecast_window.source: M0 starting choice for recent observations. Audit sensitivity in M3.

increase_z.source: Team specification §4.3 demonstrator rule. Positive-side gate under approximate independent Gaussian errors.
